regular safe project relative path
Git object available and exact bytes match before migration

key helper UUID
full local parent statement/status/assumptions included

exit_codes.0: operation/readable view success, not product approval

errors.CONTRACT_UNSUPPORTED: 不支持的合同或读者，禁止回退
errors.PREPARE_REQUIRED: 未显式准备/参与范围未批准
errors.ORIGIN_UNAVAILABLE: 原Git对象/字节/格式/引用不可恢复
errors.SOURCE_UNSUPPORTED: 当前来源依赖首批未支持复合链
errors.PLAN_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED: 当前活动源与key/版本集合不一致
errors.WORLD_UNKNOWN: 输入/环境/来源身份无法确定
errors.ASSESSMENT_REQUIRED: 缺当前判断或世界变化
errors.REVIEW_INCOMPLETE: 变化/目标/必要判断不完整
errors.REVIEW_NOT_INDEPENDENT: 未提供符合宿主要求的新上下文审查
errors.NEGATIVE_UNRESOLVED: 同一障碍未被针对性新证据/权威解除
errors.EXECUTION_UNAVAILABLE: 当前完整attempt失败/缺失/中断/漂移
errors.WORKSPACE_BUSY: 锁/未结束执行阻止操作
errors.LEGACY_WRITER_DISABLED: 新合同不接受旧判断写入
errors.PROJECTION_STALE: 生成视图不匹配权威，需重建而非重测
errors.DOWNGRADE_UNSAFE: 存在切换后事实/判断，不能自动恢复旧合同
